Geographies Served Programs Mobility State Karnataka States Karnataka proVISION ASIA offers a range of mobility aids, including wheelchairs, walkers, crutches, canes, and blind sticks. Monthly mobility distributions are organized in both rural and urban areas throughout Karnataka. These aids are tailored to address specific disabilities and are distributed to individuals accordingly. Additionally, proVISION ASIA extends its support by donating these specialized mobility aids to hospitals, other NGOs, police stations, retirement centers, and government offices. Disability Awareness State Karnataka States Karnataka proVISION ASIA provides training to students and adults on "How to be a better friend to someone who is differently-abled." The organization conducts service learning training in corporations, delivers customised assemblies in schools, offers contextual classroom instruction, teaches sign language, and facilitates choreography and group interactions. This comprehensive approach aims to shift the focus of disability awareness in a new light. From Pre-K to postgraduate programs, proVISION ASIA believes in the transformative power of education and inclusion, recognizing their impact on individuals across various age groups. Mithra Special School State Karnataka States Karnataka The school envisions fostering independence in children with disabilities, emphasizing a holistic approach that encompasses academic, social, physical, aesthetic, and spiritual growth. Currently, there are 35 enrolled students who face intellectual and physical challenges. The school's administrative structure includes a Principal, an Administrator, two primary teachers, two co-teachers, two teachers' assistants, and additional support staff. Empowher State Karnataka States Karnataka The objective is to offer high-quality education to women impacted by disability with the goal of facilitating their employment. proVISION ASIA is fervently dedicated to witnessing the success of women with disabilities within the community. The empowHER project entails a three-month certificate course, concentrating on spoken English, fundamental computer skills, and personal development. Milestones & Track Record ProVision Asia was founded in 1986 by Dr. Chip and Jean Kingery, and has since grown to offer a wide range of services including a special needs school called Mithra and monthly mobility aid distributions across Karnataka. --> --> Leadership Team Thomas Selvanayagam Trustee Christine Jamal Trustee Pratima Bobby Aruldoss Secretary Krupa Paulson Director - People and Programs Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATP3465A Registration Number 811/98-99 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID KA/2017/0173807 --> 80G DIT(E)BLR/80G/41/AAATP3465A/ITO(E)-2/Vol. 2011-12 12A Trust/718/10A/Vol. VOL II/P.207/CIT II FCRA 094421080 About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 1999 Demographies Served Youth Women Children Specially Abled --> Impact ProVision Asia has impacted and helped over 6,000 persons with disabilities through their various programs and services.
